function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您需要今天美國黃金（即美元計價的黃金）即時價格，建議您參考以下幾個常用來源：

| 來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供實時黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格，並附有歷史走勢圖。 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融新聞網站，提供即時黃金價格及相關分析。 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 亦提供即時黃金價格與市場動態。 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 以圖表方式呈現即時價格，並可設定提醒。 |

如果您想要更精確的數字（例如「今日收盤價」或「最新報價」），請直接前往上述網站或使用金融資訊服務（如 Bloomberg Terminal、Reuters Eikon 等）。如果您需要其他相關資訊（如黃金投資策略、歷史走勢分析等），也歡迎再告訴我！
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or explain. We can also ask for clarification. Probably best to say we don't have real-time data.
